invented_facts: The 30B model required 128 GB for meaningful performance; the tested 64 GB Vantage Pro 16 reached 15 tokens per second.
The prose reports sustained throughput as roughly 10–12% below peak, but the paper reports about 12% for Aurora 14 and 9% for Vantage Pro 16.
notes: The summary is concise and VP-oriented, and it preserves Vantage's image-generation advantage. It omits three required caveats: only one Vantage configuration was tested, the language models used 4-bit quantization, and output quality was not evaluated.
